name: Reliable Backup & Sync Execution Validation (Log-Driven) - Public V2

parameters.content:
### Schedule
Daily at **09:30 Europe/Rome**, after the configured log upload cutoff (08:10).

### Presence decision
Missing expected logs → Gmail. Available logs are analyzed independently.

### 📂 GCS Object Listing

**List objects in Google Cloud Storage**

Target path:

```
sync-logs/<hostname>/YYYY/MM/DD/
```

All objects for the current day are retrieved and passed downstream
for validation and optional content analysis.

## Reliable Backup & Sync Execution Validation (Log-Driven)

Monitor backup/sync logs stored in GCS. Compare expected jobs from GitHub, validate execution markers and send deterministic or AI alerts.

### Setup
Configure GCS bucket and host, GitHub manifest, Gmail recipients, OpenAI credentials and scheduling. Test before activation.

### Documentation
[Complete Setup Guide](https://paoloronco.notion.site/Documentation-Reliable-Backup-Sync-Execution-Validation-Log-Driven-403f0ba27c3280179a84fb206e06481a)

### Professional Services & Consulting
For professional consulting, tailored solutions, or collaboration opportunities, feel free to get in touch.

**Email:** info@paoloronco.it  
**Website:** https://paoloronco.it

### 🧩 Context Setup

**Runtime context initialization**

* Defines bucket name and host identifier
* Computes current date (UTC)
* Prepares variables used across the workflow

This keeps the workflow deterministic and date-driven.

### Log presence check
Compare the expected daily/weekly/monthly job logs with objects found in GCS.

### 📧 Email Alert – Missing Logs

**Alert: missing backup/sync logs**

Triggered when at least one expected log file
is not found in today’s GCS path.

The email includes:
* Date
* Host
* Bucket and path
* Exact list of missing files

### Execution error email
Sent for failed, incomplete or warning-bearing log executions.

### Download available logs
Each GCS log is downloaded for deterministic and AI analysis, even when another expected log is missing.

### Deterministic log parser
Checks lifecycle markers, return code, errors and warnings. Supports structured rsync/rclone and OneDrive text logs.

### AI Log Analyzer
Reads one log and returns JSON findings, severity and recommended actions.

### AI Alert Decision
Sends email only when severity or evidence meets the notification policy.

### Expected jobs
Fetch and decode `sync-jobs.json` from GitHub. Set required log filenames and schedules.

### Binary to text
Converts downloaded log files into UTF-8 for the AI branch.

## Part 1 — Log Presence Validation

Deterministic check: do all expected logs exist?
This section verifies that all expected backup jobs have produced a log
for the current execution day.

## Part 2 — Execution Validation
Deterministic parsing and failure notifications.

## Part 3 — AI Log Analysis
Review downloaded log contents for additional anomalies.

### Execution decision
Send an alert when the parser returns `ok=false`.
